# Clankie

Clankie is a local-first agent system for Apple-silicon Macs with a terminal UI and an optional iPhone and iPad app.
The Mac remains authoritative. The app reaches it through a narrow public gateway and does not require Tailscale.

- User paths and setup: https://docs.clankie.bot/
- Privacy: https://clankie.bot/privacy/
- Support: https://clankie.bot/support/
- Public network surface: https://docs.clankie.bot/network/
- Source: https://github.com/Volpestyle/clankie
